t: This is a bust of Edward the Seventh, a sculpture here in Tower Hamlets. It shows the king who reigned over the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and was Emperor of India, from January 1901 until he died in 1910. A bust gives you just the head and shoulders, so look at the face and the way it has been carved. It's one of the ways the borough chose to remember a monarch whose reign was short, lasting only nine years.
